adoption-and-inheritance.include: Belonging to God's family and receiving a child's inheritance.
adoption-and-inheritance.exclude: General references to believers as children, without adoption or inheritance as a central theme.

atonement-and-redemption.include: Christ's sacrificial death, ransom, and the freedom it purchases.
atonement-and-redemption.exclude: Every passage that mentions Christ or salvation.

forgiveness-and-reconciliation.include: God pardoning sin, removing estrangement, and restoring peace with himself.
forgiveness-and-reconciliation.exclude: Forgiving another person; general peace of mind.

justification-in-christ.include: Acceptance before God through Christ's righteousness rather than personal merit.
justification-in-christ.exclude: Every mention of grace, faith, or righteous conduct.

life-in-christ.include: New life, union with Christ, and sharing in his life and spiritual blessings.
life-in-christ.exclude: Christ as an incidental source of help in an otherwise different subject.

work-of-the-holy-spirit.include: The Spirit's indwelling, renewal, sanctification, leading, comfort, and seal.
work-of-the-holy-spirit.exclude: Spiritual language or Christian virtues without a central connection to the Spirit.

consecration-to-god.include: Wholehearted allegiance to God and offering one's life and actions to him.
consecration-to-god.exclude: Every commandment or instance of good conduct.

love-for-god-and-christ.include: Loving, treasuring, and delighting personally in God or Christ.
love-for-god-and-christ.exclude: God's love for us; every poem addressed to Christ.

gods-love-and-mercy.include: God's undeserved love, patient mercy, and gift of salvation.
gods-love-and-mercy.exclude: Grace language that supports a different dominant theme.

gods-guidance.include: God personally leading, teaching, and directing the believer's course.
gods-guidance.exclude: Any moral instruction or incidental reference to a path.

refuge-in-trouble.include: God's presence, protection, and rescue amid danger or distress.
refuge-in-trouble.exclude: Every treatment of suffering, temptation, or heavenly hope.

trust-in-providence.include: Confidence in God's care, provision, faithfulness, and ordering of present life.
trust-in-providence.exclude: Faith in Christ for justification; every general use of trust or hope.

perseverance-in-faith.include: Continuing in faith and good works, and God's keeping believers to the end.
perseverance-in-faith.exclude: Any isolated act of obedience or warning about sin.

scripture-and-meditation.include: Reading, loving, keeping, and reflecting on Scripture as a source of truth and help.
scripture-and-meditation.exclude: The presence of a Bible quotation in an entry.

drawing-near-in-prayer.include: Approaching God in private or shared prayer, being heard, and seeking his help.
drawing-near-in-prayer.exclude: A poem taking the form of a prayer without prayer itself as a central subject.

intercession.include: Christ or the Spirit interceding, or believers praying specifically for others.
intercession.exclude: Every prayer for one's own need.

praise-and-thanksgiving.include: Deliberately thanking and praising God for his works and gifts.
praise-and-thanksgiving.exclude: A closing phrase of thanks in an otherwise different subject.

serving-others.include: Good works directed toward a neighbour's good, practical charity, and bearing others' burdens.
serving-others.exclude: Every instance of obedience, consecration, or personal holiness.

church-fellowship.include: Belonging, gathering, worshipping, and maintaining unity within the church.
church-fellowship.exclude: All interactions with other people; a passing mention of saints.

forgiving-and-loving-enemies.include: Responding to wrongs with forgiveness, forbearance, peace, and love.
forgiving-and-loving-enemies.exclude: God forgiving our sins; all neighbourly kindness.

gospel-witness.include: Confessing and defending the gospel, a public Christian example, and concern for others' salvation.
gospel-witness.exclude: Every mention of Christ or doing good.

honesty-and-speech.include: Truthfulness, integrity, a clear conscience, and speech that helps rather than harms.
honesty-and-speech.exclude: General moral instruction without honesty or communication at its centre.

work-and-stewardship.include: Using time, opportunities, possessions, work, and civic responsibilities faithfully.
work-and-stewardship.exclude: Generic good works without a specific responsibility or resource in view.

humility-and-meekness.include: Renouncing pride, acknowledging dependence, and treating others gently.
humility-and-meekness.exclude: Every confession or instance of suffering.

self-control-and-self-denial.include: Governing desires and passions, rejecting worldly attachment, and giving up personal advantage.
self-control-and-self-denial.exclude: All resistance to sin; resisting external pressure without self indulgence at issue.

watchfulness.include: Recognising spiritual danger, avoiding occasions of sin, and guarding against drift.
watchfulness.exclude: All temptation passages or general calls to holiness.

repentance-and-self-examination.include: Recognising and confessing sin, examining one's ways, and returning to God.
repentance-and-self-examination.exclude: Forgiveness offered to the believer without a central call to repentance.

patience-in-suffering.include: Enduring affliction, waiting patiently, and submitting to God amid sorrow.
patience-in-suffering.exclude: All sorrow or any mention of future comfort.

purpose-in-affliction.include: Trials testing or refining faith, teaching dependence, and preparing believers for glory.
purpose-in-affliction.exclude: Every promise of help or relief during trouble.

joy-in-salvation.include: Rejoicing in Christ, acceptance, pardon, and the blessings of salvation.
joy-in-salvation.exclude: Every source of joy, including work, fellowship, temporal gifts, or heaven.

resisting-temptation.include: The conflict with indwelling sin or Satan and active resistance through faith and spiritual armour.
resisting-temptation.exclude: Every specific vice or passage promising Christ's help without emphasising the conflict.

christs-help-in-weakness.include: Christ's strength, rest, comfort, protection, and sympathy for weak or tempted believers.
christs-help-in-weakness.exclude: Every reference to Christ; the distinct work of the Holy Spirit.

facing-death.include: Human frailty, mortality, and facing one's death, including the believer's hope and peace.
facing-death.exclude: Bereavement for someone else; the resurrection body or final judgment.

resurrection-of-the-body.include: The dead rising, bodily immortality and transformation, and reunion grounded in resurrection.
resurrection-of-the-body.exclude: Every passage about heaven or Christ returning as judge.

christs-return-and-judgment.include: Christ's appearing, the world's end, judgment, acquittal, and rewards at his coming.
christs-return-and-judgment.exclude: Any reference to heaven or a believer's present justification.

heavens-rest-and-joy.include: The promised home, rest, freedom from sorrow, and lasting happiness beyond this life.
heavens-rest-and-joy.exclude: Every future hope; heavenly worship, service, or fellowship as distinct subjects.

gods-presence-in-heaven.include: Being with God and Christ, beholding their glory, knowing fully, and living in God's light.
gods-presence-in-heaven.exclude: Every reference to heaven, future rest, or victory.

heavenly-worship-and-fellowship.include: Heavenly worship, service, communion with the saints, and their reunion.
heavenly-worship-and-fellowship.exclude: Every reference to heaven, personal glory, or rest.

glory-and-reigning-with-christ.include: Believers' final perfection, glory, victory, and sharing in Christ's kingdom.
glory-and-reigning-with-christ.exclude: Every present victory over sin or promise of heavenly rest.

growth-in-holiness.include: Becoming holy, bearing righteous fruit, and final freedom from sin.
growth-in-holiness.exclude: Every good deed or instance of self discipline.

grieving-a-loss.include: For the death of someone loved and the hope of reunion.
grieving-a-loss.exclude: Generic sorrow without bereavement in view.

afraid-of-death.include: For fear of one's own death, with passages that directly address dying and life beyond the grave.
afraid-of-death.exclude: All references to heaven, mortality, or the end of the world.

worried-about-provision.include: For anxiety about material loss, daily needs, or future support.
worried-about-provision.exclude: General discouragement or warnings about loving riches.

regretting-past-sins.include: For confronting past wrongdoing and returning to God in confession and repentance.
regretting-past-sins.exclude: Every promise of pardon or general statement about sin.

hurt-by-others.include: For mistreatment, betrayal, hostility, and the struggle to respond without retaliation.
hurt-by-others.exclude: Generic fellowship, neighbourly love, or all moral duties.

fighting-recurring-sin.include: For repeated failure, inward sinful desires, and the struggle to resist them.
fighting-recurring-sin.exclude: All trials, external persecution, or every warning about temptation.

seeking-direction.include: For understanding God's way through his leading, Scripture, and careful reflection.
seeking-direction.exclude: All moral instruction or any mention of a road.
